mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS on 20-day forward returns remains below 0.03 across any 3-year rolling window or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% or average 5-day returns during such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in CPIAUCSL signals monetary policy response to inflation, which precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic resilience.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, industrial production decline below 100 (index) signals weakening manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 during late-cycle expansions or average returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction activity (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST on 5-day forward returns remains below 0.03 across any 3-year rolling window or average 5-day returns during rising HOUST periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100 (index) signals manufacturing contraction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as economic slowdown fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 or average 60-day returns during such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates labor market stress and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between UNRATE and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive policy that raises borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% during tightening cycles or average returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
